groups.defect: The admin and account SPA English bundles replace i18next placeholders with unsupported Java MessageFormat placeholders and choice syntax.
groups.rationale: All six report the same interpolation mistake repeated in the two SPA bundles. Both resource entries need correction; s_c090859a describes the same admin entry despite its inconsistent file path.

groups.defect: The same Italian TOTP instruction was copied into the Lithuanian account and login bundles.
groups.rationale: These suggestions report the identical wrong-language replacement repeated in totpStep1 and loginTotpStep1. Both entries need Lithuanian text.

groups.defect: An unavailable derived English reference file causes an unchecked RuntimeException that aborts verification instead of using the existing findings or checked-exception contract.
groups.rationale: Both identify the same English-bundle loading failure and unchecked exception at lines 73–80.

groups.defect: Overlapping common-prefix and common-suffix counts cause invalid substring bounds while constructing the illegal-HTML diagnostic.
groups.rationale: The examples differ, but both failures arise from the same unbounded suffix trimming and substring calls. One bounds correction resolves both.

groups.defect: The zh_CN account bundle contains a Traditional Chinese totpStep1 instruction instead of Simplified Chinese.
groups.rationale: Both report the same script mismatch in the exact same resource entry.
